title: Privacy-Friendly Cohort Determination: Sealed, CSP-Independent In-Browser ML Inference of Professional Segments for Identity-Less Advertising
abstract: arXiv:2609.36153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: B2B advertising targets a viewer's professional attributes (employer size and industry, function, seniority) and has obtained them by matching identities across sites. Safari and Firefox block third-party cookies, Google retired the Privacy Sandbox cohort APIs in 2025, and reverse-IP firmographics decay under remote work. We present SIF (Sealed Inference Frame), which infers coarse professional cohorts on the device and emits only a locally differentially private, taxonomy-coded label into the OpenRTB bid stream, with no cross-site identifier. It rests on a property of the web platform we make precise: a navigated cross-origin iframe is the only way third-party code obtains a policy it controls, so inference runs in WebAssembly even where the publisher's CSP forbids it, and a nested worker served with default-src 'none' gives the model no network. Even a malicious model leaks at most about 5 bits per site per week. Labels pass through

translated_title: 隐私友好的群体判定：密封的、独立于CSP的浏览器内机器学习职业群体推断，用于无身份广告
translated_abstract: B2B广告针对受众的职业属性（雇主规模和行业、职能、资历），并历来通过跨站点身份匹配来获取这些属性。Safari和Firefox封锁了第三方Cookie，Google于2025年退役了Privacy Sandbox群体API，而在远程办公普及的背景下，基于反向IP的企业属性数据也逐渐失效。我们提出SIF（密封推断框架，Sealed Inference Frame），它在设备端推断粗粒度的职业群体，并仅将一个经本地差分隐私处理、按分类法编码的标签输出到OpenRTB竞价流中，不使用任何跨站点标识符。该方法基于我们精确刻画的一个Web平台特性：导航式跨源iframe是第三方代码获得其可控策略的唯一途径，因此即使发布者的内容安全策略（CSP）禁止相关执行环境，推断仍可在WebAssembly中运行；同时，由default-src 'none'策略服务的嵌套Worker使模型无法访问网络。即使是恶意模型，每周每个站点至多也只泄露约5比特的信息。
tldr: 提出SIF框架，在设备端通过密封的浏览器内机器学习推断粗粒度职业群体标签，即使发布者CSP禁止也能运行，并以本地差分隐私方式输出标签，在无跨站点标识符的情况下实现隐私友好的B2B广告定向。
en_tdlr: SIF enables privacy-friendly identity-less B2B advertising by performing sealed, CSP-independent in-browser ML inference of professional cohorts on-device, emitting only locally differentially private taxonomy-coded labels with no cross-site identifier.
